title: Earthy Pudding Delight
description: A rich and creamy dessert made with earthy ingredients, perfect for a warm evening.
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle gelatin over 1/4 cup of cold water and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
In a medium saucepan, combine the earthy pudding mix, sugar, and 1 cup of milk. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and add in the softened gelatin, stirring until it's fully dissolved.
Add in the vanilla extract and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into a 9x13 inch baking dish and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or until set.
Once set, cut into squares and serve.
To make the Malaysian jellylike dessert, follow the package instructions for cooking and setting.
Once set, cut into small cubes and serve alongside the earthy pudding.
You can garnish with additional earthy pudding or Malaysian jellylike dessert, if desired.
